events.title: NAIDOC Week – Botanical Eco-Printing & Dot Art Workshops
events.location: Coolum, Kawana, Caloundra, Nambour & Maroochydore Libraries
events.description: Celebrate NAIDOC Week by discovering natural colours through botanical eco-printing and learning Aboriginal storytelling traditions with dot art. These free, hands-on workshops are available at various libraries across the Sunshine Coast.

events.title: NAIDOC Week Celebration
events.description: A vibrant community celebration of NAIDOC Week, honouring 50 years with the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander community. Enjoy live First Nations performances, market stalls, music, cultural workshops, and storytelling.

events.title: GATHAA First Nations Markets
events.description: Celebrate "50 Years of Deadly" during NAIDOC Week at these vibrant markets, featuring First Nations businesses, live music, cultural performances, bushfood experiences, and creative workshops for all ages.

events.title: Dreaming Collective Sunshine Coast NAIDOC Gala
events.description: A special evening honouring "50 Years of Deadly" and the strength, resilience, and cultural brilliance of First Nations peoples. Features live performances, arts, awards, and a two-course dinner for community, artists, and allies.

events.title: Festival of the Harvest – NAIDOC Celebration
events.location: Kabi Kabi Country (Sunshine Coast, specific location TBA)
events.description: A free NAIDOC celebration hosted by Undumbi Culture, bringing people together with music, dance, storytelling, bush tucker, Indigenous markets, and hands-on cultural experiences for all ages.

events.title: LORE | Land – Exhibition Opening
events.location: Caloundra Regional Gallery, 22 Omrah Avenue, Caloundra
events.description: An exhibition grounded in First Nations deep cultural knowledge and ancestral connections, led by Jinibara artist Jennifer Kent and featuring the First Nations Screenprint Collective. 'Old Ways, New Marks' showcases contemporary screen-print works by emerging First Nations artists, revealing enduring relationships with land, culture, and community while exploring themes of identity and resistance.

events.title: NAIDOC Week – Council Flag Raising
events.description: Join the community on Kabi Kabi Country for the annual flag raising, celebrating the history, culture, and achievements of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples with the 2026 theme "Fifty Years of Deadly."

events.title: NAIDOC Week Programming
events.location: All Sunshine Coast Libraries (Coolum, Kawana, Caloundra, Nambour, Maroochydore)
events.description: A week-long program across all Sunshine Coast Libraries celebrating NAIDOC Week's "50 Years of Deadly." Includes workshops, curated book displays, dot art activities, and botanical eco-printing.

events.title: The Lorax – Free Community Film Screening
events.datetime: Week of 29 June – 5 July (Exact date TBC)
events.description: A family-friendly screening of "The Lorax" at Library+ Caloundra, held as a free community event to support Plastic Free July and promote sustainability.

events.title: Noosa Arts Theatre – July Production Preview
events.description: Check the website for potential preview performances of Noosa Arts Theatre's July production, which formally opens on July 9th. Details regarding the specific play and early showings would be on their website.
